physical.area_reference_basis: McPAT non-cache area plus local CACTI L1I/L1D/L2 area for 4-core 32kB/512kB reference

thermal_stack.calibration: Earlier Table III thermal anchor calibration retained; rerun calibration after switching cache geometry to local CACTI before formal claims.

parameter_provenance.alpha: pre-validation candidate; do not cite as accepted
parameter_provenance.cross_tier_weight: pre-validation candidate; do not cite as accepted
parameter_provenance.lambda_wire: zero only to isolate thermal calibration; R2 required

paper: 32x32 power grid on each active tier
T_safe=95 C, T_amb=25 C, f_min=0.4 GHz
reproduction_assumptions: alpha, beta, cross-tier weight, and lambda_wire are not numerically disclosed by the paper; defaults are explicit and configurable.
McPAT uses direct gem5 O3 counters; its reported dynamic and leakage powers are consumed without post-processing multipliers.
Cache delay, area, and aspect-ratio-preserving geometry come only from the local CACTI run; no published cache table values are used.
The 8.72 effective local stack-resistance factor came from an earlier Table III temperature anchor and should be recalibrated after local-CACTI geometry changes.
CLIP-3D proposals and fixed-bin are both validated with real HotSpot; a guard prevents a proxy-induced thermal-BIPS regression and records any fallback.
Cool3D-standard and SA+lambda details are under-specified; their deterministic reproduction algorithms record all parameters and candidates.
